metadata.title: MPAS quasi-uniform x1.642 (N=642 cells, ~480 km)
metadata.description: MPAS Voronoi mesh with 642 cells, 1920 edges, max_edges=6. Quasi-uniform global sphere; 12 pentagons + 630 hexagons. Loader path is repo-relative; supply reader_fn(path) -> MpasMeshData at bind time (NetCDF I/O not bundled per GRIDS_API.md §10).
